text:
Jess: Quick async standup for adoption microsprint — Lighthouse renewal escalations. What I did: triaged webhook timeout causing 504s for Lighthouse, reproduced on staging; found retry loop in customer adapter that spikes latencies. Blockers: need eng to review hotfix; product asks to avoid behavior change for other customers. Today: test fix on staging, roll canary to one region if green, prepare notes for renewal call Wed.

Mike: on it. Can you paste the failing request/stack? I remember we patched adapter last quarter.

Jess: pasted trace and curl to reproduce:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/customers/lighthouse/events \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
 -d '{"event":"session.closed","session_id":"abc-123"}'
```
Stack shows `adapter.process -> adapter.retry_loop`

Nina: fyi prod alerts started 2:03am, routed to oncall but flapped after retries :alarm_clock:

Ada: tagging @mike — I can submit a PR for a conservative fix to limit retries to 3 and add jitter. Will run unit tests. Any objections?

Sam: +1 from support. We need to add a metric so we can monitor retries per customer. Can we emit counter `adapter_retry_attempts{customer}`?

Mike: ok I'll review Ada's PR. Quick note: if we change retry behavior we should fallback to queueing to SQS for Lighthouse to avoid immediate failures during surge.

Jess: good point. For the renewal call we promised SLA remediation steps — if we queue, explain tradeoffs and estimate added latency (~200-400ms).

Ada: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/582 — added retry cap, jitter, and a Prometheus counter. Tests pass locally. Requesting review :eyes: 

Mike: reviewing now. @deploy-bot can you snapshot staging cluster config? We need to confirm earlier canary didn't have the env var `ADAPTER_RETRY_LIMIT=0` set by mistake.

deploy-bot: snapshot created: cluster-staging-2468001123.tar.gz (uploaded to https://s3.redwood-inference/staging-snapshots/2468001123) :package: 

Mike: LGTM on PR with one minor nit in docs. I'll merge and kick a canary to `staging-us-west-2-canary`.

Jess: awesome. After canary, if metrics look good I'll draft renewal note and tag @sam. ETA for canary: 30–45m.

Sam: will prepare customer-facing wording. Also can someone add a short playbook note in CS wiki for this class of failures?

Nina: I'll take the wiki edit.

Jess: thanks team. I'll update thread after canary results. :thumbsup:
